evals.name: install-dry-run-then-commit
evals.prompt: Enforce that our metrics services are scraped by a ServiceMonitor.
evals.expected_output: Runs `cub manage preflight`, previews `cub manage observability guardrails install` (dry-run), then on confirmation `guardrails install --commit`, and explains the rule reads the ServiceMonitors on each Service's cluster, so nothing else needs running. Trigger is Warn=true.

evals.name: flag-uncovered
evals.prompt: Make the uncovered metrics services show a warning.
evals.expected_output: Installs the pack if it is not installed (dry-run, then --commit), and explains that the observability-servicemonitor-coverage rule flags uncovered metrics Services by itself as their Units change; checks with `cub manage guardrails status`.

evals.name: status
evals.prompt: Which services are flagged by the observability guardrails?
evals.expected_output: Runs `cub manage guardrails status` and reports Units with ValidationWarnings/ValidationErrors. Read-only.

evals.name: routes-fix-elsewhere
evals.expected_output: Routes to observability-instrument (`cub manage observability ensure-servicemonitor`) to remediate, rather than fixing from the guardrails skill.
